plan.failureSummary: Cached page.ai instructions replayed a stale positional selector that clicked 'Solutions' instead of 'Developers', leading to the wrong page and causing the URL assertion to fail.
observedIndicators: The page.ai cache for 'Click on the Developers dropdown menu, then click into to the Documentation option' contained a positional selector '#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button'.
Tool history shows the deterministic replay clicked the 'Solutions' button rather than 'Developers', navigating to '/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/'.
The test assertion expect(page.url()).toEqual('https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/') failed due to landing on the Solutions page.
The failure screenshot confirms that 'Developers' is present on the live navbar.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai deterministic cache and retry autonomous execution
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached page.ai instructions for checkly.test.ts and rerun the test so page.ai dynamically targets the current 'Developers' dropdown button and navigates to the docs page.

plan.notes: The live page still has the 'Developers' navigation dropdown and documentation links as expected by the test intent. Re-running without stale deterministic cache will resolve the selector issue.
